opportunities.name: Country macro snapshot email
opportunities.description: Look up a country's GDP, growth and population on World Bank and its capital and currency on Wikipedia, then write a 'macro snapshot' email to a recipient.
steps: Open World Bank data and search for {country}
Open the country page; read GDP (US$), GDP growth % and population with their latest year
Search Wikipedia for {country}; read capital and currency (name and ISO code)
Set Body = 'Hi {recipient_name}, {country}: GDP US${gdp} ({year}), growth {growth}%, population {population} ({year}); capital {capital}, currency {currency} ({code}).'
Send the email (the user clicked Discard in the recording)

instances.values: country=Vietnam (World Bank lists it as 'Viet Nam'), recipient=raj@example.com

opportunities.name: Log a Gutenberg book to the reading notes
opportunities.description: Find a book on Project Gutenberg, look up the author's birth and death years on Wikipedia, and save a 'Read:' note with title, author, years, Gutenberg release date and download count.
steps: Open the matching result; read author, release date and download count
Search Wikipedia for {author}; read birth and death years
Type 'Read: {title} by {author} ({birth}-{death}), Gutenberg since {release_date}, {downloads} downloads' and press Enter
